description: A bulky, armoured grey-brown dinosaur with a deep snout stoops in a dark forest floor, browsing a sprig of green plant with its mouth while one forelimb reaches down with a pointed thumb spike visible among the fingers. Ferns and horsetail stalks surround it, with a dim canopy of trunks behind. The style is a dark oil painting with visible brushwork. No text, no frame, no people.
